assumptions.period: one period of war, say a year; the numbers are assumptions that show trends

read_surface: the nodes that received every substation's feeder states (the island's allocation)
pass_rule: A, B substations receive only their own commands and state; C, D validators and substations receive every substation's states and commands and the measurements
known_issues: C and D's substations receive whole blocks because the commit proof signs the whole block; a Merkle root of the commands in the header would let each substation get only its own commands with a proof (future work), shrinking C and D's read surface to the 7 validators
A and B's standby centre receives every state report but no measurements until it takes over
what is visible is not hidden by encryption here: confidential BFT (secret sharing) and data minimisation are the design doc's answers to question 29
